caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a light beige background: a skirt-shaped garment rendered in shades of brown and tan. The garment features a structured waistband with a slight vertical slit at the back. The upper section of the skirt displays diagonal quilting in a diamond pattern, while the middle section contains horizontal, interwoven bands. The lower section is adorned with a pattern of large, intersecting circles composed of concentric rings. The shading and lines emphasize texture and dimensionality across the surface. The artist’s signature "Rex Bush" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Quilted Petticoat
